description: Connector for the Nokia 5110 / 3310 84 x 48 monochrome LCD module (PCD8544 controller, SPI, 3.3 V): a 1x8 2.54 mm pin header, RST CE DC DIN CLK VCC BL GND as the common red module prints them

datasheet.revision: the common red module's silkscreen; Philips PCD8544 product specification (1999 Apr 12)

package.name: pin header 1x08 2.54mm
package.page: a 1x8 pin header at 2.54 mm for the cable to the module: pin 1 square

footprint:
pinHeader(8) with {
models = [
  Model3d { path = "Connector_PinHeader_2.54mm:PinHeader_1x08_P2.54mm_Vertical", hide = true },
]
solids = concat(
  [
    slab(-1.27mm, -10.16mm, 0mm, 1.27mm, 10.16mm, 2.5mm, color = "#141416"),
    slab(-41.4mm, -21.55mm, 2.5mm, 2.2mm, 21.55mm, 3.5mm, color = "#b3202a"),
  ],
  map(range(0, 8), i => solid.box(
    (0.64mm, 0.64mm, 4.4mm),
    at = (0mm, clean((3.5 - i) * 2.54mm), 0mm),
    material = .gold,
  )),
  map(
    displayPanel(
      box((-34.35mm, -18mm), (-8.85mm, 18mm)),
      box((-30.25mm, -15.1mm), (-12.95mm, 15.1mm)),
      2.8mm,
      frame = box((-38.1mm, -19.5mm), (-5.1mm, 19.5mm)),
      face = "#9da697",
      mask = "#8e978a",
    ),
    p => p with { at = (p.at[0], p.at[1], clean(p.at[2] + 3.5mm)) },
  ),
)
}

pins.name: CE
pins.description: chip enable (SPI chip select), active low

pins.name: DIN
pins.description: serial data in (MOSI), up to 4 Mbit/s

pins.name: BL
pins.description: backlight LEDs (through a resistor; some boards switch them to GND, others to VCC)

notes: 3.3 V supply and logic: from a 5 V controller put 10 kohm in series with each signal line or a level shifter.
Two pin orders exist: this one (RST CE DC DIN CLK VCC BL GND, the red module) and the blue SparkFun one (VCC GND SCE RST D/C DN SCLK LED). Read the silkscreen.
The backlight pin's polarity differs between boards: drive it through about 330 ohm and check whether yours lights with BL high or low.

pins.source: the red Nokia 5110 module's silkscreen as sellers and tutorials document it (RST, CE, DC, DIN, CLK, VCC, BL/LIGHT, GND); Philips PCD8544 specification: VDD 2.7-3.3 V, serial interface up to 4.0 Mbit/s
pins.license: pinout and dimensions transcribed from the vendor's published documentation (facts); footprint, 3D body, descriptions and notes our own

footprint.note: a plain 1x8 2.54 mm header for the module's cable or a socket
